transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Um, well, I came in because I'm just so tired. I can barely get through a shift at work right now. It feels like... like my body is just filled with wet sand. And even when I lay down, resting doesn't really bring me back. I just can't seem to shake it.
How long have you been feeling this way with the fatigue?

Um, it's been about four months now. This whole low, empty feeling... it started a while after I had this big rush of energy at work. But once that passed, the tiredness just kind of took over, and it's been like this ever since.
Have you ever felt this way before, with similar feelings of tiredness or low mood, or is this the first time you've experienced something like this?

Um, I don't really think so. I mean, I've had days where I'm just exhausted after a long shift at the register, but... not like this. Not where it lasts for months at a time and I can't shake it. So, yeah, I'm pretty sure this is the first time it's ever been this bad.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks in a row, before this current episode?

Um, no, not really before this current time. Like I said, this is the first time it's been like this. But right now, during these last few months? Yeah, definitely. Things I usually love to do, um... like cooking for myself, playing guitar, hiking, or even going over to my family’s place... they all just feel flat now. It’s like I’m only pretending to care about them.
Have you experienced a period of at least two weeks where you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, or lost interest in activities you usually enjoy?

Yeah, like I was just saying, that's exactly what's happening right now. It's been way longer than two weeks. For these last four months, I've felt down pretty much the entire day, every day. And I just don't care about the things I normally like to do anymore.
Have you noticed any other changes besides feeling tired and losing interest in things, like your sleep, appetite, concentration, or feelings about yourself?

Well, yeah, my appetite has been all over the place. Lately, though, I mostly just... forget to eat. Or when I do, the food just tastes like cardboard, you know? I don't really have the energy to care about it. And, um, I guess I've lost some weight because of it. My work pants have definitely been fitting a lot looser recently.
Have you found yourself feeling like a failure or blaming yourself for things more than usual lately?

Yeah, I have. I just... I keep thinking I've let everybody down. My manager at work, my family, even my little nieces. It's like I can't do anything right. I'll be at the cash register and make a mistake, and I just replay it in my head over and over. It just feels like it proves I'm no good at anything.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or unable to sit still?

Well, it's kind of been both. At first, I couldn't sit still. I was constantly pacing around the store, just straightening up shelves over and over because I felt so restless. But lately... it's the opposite. Everything just feels heavy. Even walking to the bus stop after my shift, or just answering a customer's question, it all feels really slowed down and takes so much effort.
Have you had any thoughts about ending your life or that you'd be better off dead?

Yeah, I have. It's... it's been pretty scary, honestly. I've had these thoughts that maybe everyone would just be better off if I didn't wake up at all. And a few times, when I'm walking home from the bus stop, I've caught myself thinking about just... stepping off the curb right into traffic.
